capabilities: Discover live radio stations through the Radio Browser directory with a curated fallback list
Play, pause, and switch stations with volume control and one retry on stream failure
Search stations by name and switch between mood channels such as focus, jazz, and classical
Save favorite stations and listening history in the current vault
Reorder recommendations based on likes, skips, and recent listening
extras: Licensed under GPL v3 with a separate commercial license for closed-source use. Listed in the community directory but manual Obsidian review is still queued; iOS/Android hardware testing is not yet claimed. The same repository contains an independent web version of the player.
motivation: The author built it as the note-taking scenario version of their radio.qiaomu.ai web app, offering a native player view instead of embedding a web page in notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play background music or radio while reading and writing notes.

relations.evidence: 通过 Radio Browser 发现真实直播电台
目录不可用时请求 radio.qiaomu.ai 的备用目录
装了乔木Home时，主页显示正在播放与最近电台，可直接播放/暂停

summary: Radio player plugin that discovers and streams live radio stations worldwide inside Obsidian, with mood channels, favorites, history, and local recommendations.
